purpose: Post-blueprint-agent-1912 scored evidence for Starter Foundry issue 148 / issue 157. This run verifies that Blueprint Agent domain validation now searches generated workspace lanes such as apps/web/src and contracts/evm/src instead of only the primary app workdir.

verdict.plainEnglish: Blueprint Agent #1912 fixed the lane-local src glob false negative: the 3 verification artifacts produced in this run contain 0 no-files-matching src/**/* failures. Starter Foundry still routed the generic candidates correctly, with scaffold passing 4/4 leaves. Generation quality did not promote: completion passed 0/4 leaves, train scores were below the 0.500 gate for both candidates, and remaining failures are now visible as product/output gaps or domain-policy gaps instead of hidden verifier-path bugs.
remainingGeneralizationRisk: FHE domain policy still assumes a narrow dependency signal such as fhenixjs/Fhenix SDK; that may be too specific for the broader family of FHE projects Starter Foundry must route.
Bridge train aborted before verification because Kimi exited after killing a background Vite task, so that train sample proves scaffold routing but not post-1912 domain validation.
Bridge holdout and FHE leaves still miss concrete completion requirements, so this run is not evidence of lift in generation quality.
